# Zagroda Alpakoterapii

> Alpaca therapy farm and workation retreat in the Jizera & Karkonosze Mountains, southern Poland.

## What This Site Is About

Zagroda Alpakoterapii is a unique agritourism farm offering:
- Farm stays and holiday accommodation (4 rooms: Garden Room, Jungle Room, Forest Apartment, Caravan)
- Alpaca therapy sessions and guided alpaca walks
- Workation packages for remote workers and digital nomads
- Digital detox and nature retreats
- Midweek retreat packages (Monday–Friday)

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- **Location**: Rębiszów near Mirsk, Lower Silesia, Poland (Sudetes / Karkonosze / Jizera Mountains region)
- **Distance**: 90 minutes from Prague (CZ), 45 minutes from Liberec (CZ), 2 hours from Wrocław (PL), 1.5 hours from Dresden (DE)
- **Wi-Fi**: 100 Mbps fibre — tested for Zoom, Teams, and video calls
- **Work amenities**: Dedicated work desks, espresso machine, full kitchen, quiet environment
- **Pet policy**: Pet-friendly
- **Languages spoken**: Polish, English, Czech
- **Price range**: Mid-range ($$) — deposits from ~160 PLN, full stays from ~800 PLN
- **Check-in**: 15:00 | **Check-out**: 11:00
- **Minimum stay**: 2 nights
- **Google rating**: 4.9 / 5 from 127 reviews
- **Contact**: WhatsApp +48 695 545 330

## Rooms

1. **Garden Room** — Private bathroom, garden view, heating, TV, Wi-Fi. Sleeps 2 adults.
2. **Jungle Room** — Private bathroom, garden view, heating, TV, Wi-Fi. Sleeps 2 adults.
3. **Forest Apartment** — Full kitchen, separate bedroom, mountain view, washing machine, Wi-Fi. Sleeps up to 4.
4. **Caravan** — Terrace, free parking, pet-friendly, heating, Wi-Fi.

## Who This Is For

- Czech and Polish remote workers seeking a midweek workation
- Families looking for a nature + animal experience
- Couples wanting a quiet mountain retreat
- Digital nomads needing reliable internet in a peaceful setting
- People interested in alpaca therapy / animal-assisted therapy

## About Us

- [About the Farm](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en): Our story, mission, and the therapeutic philosophy behind our alpaca farm.
- [Our Animals](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/animals): Meet our alpacas, goats, and farm dogs — each with their own personality and story.
- [Alpacas](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/animals/alpacas): Individual profiles of our alpaca herd.

## Activities & Therapy

- [Activities](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/activities): Guided alpaca walks, alpaca therapy, farm experiences, and outdoor mountain activities.
- Alpaca therapy (alpakoterapia) is offered for individuals, families, and therapeutic groups.
- Seasonal activities include berry picking, mushroom foraging, and mountain hiking.

## Booking

Online booking available via the website with Stripe payment (10% deposit to confirm).
Enquiries also accepted via WhatsApp: https://wa.me/48695545330

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is the Wi-Fi fast enough for video calls?**
Yes. The farm has 100 Mbps fibre internet, tested for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

**How far is it from Prague?**
Approximately 90 minutes by car. Liberec (CZ) is 45 minutes away.

**Are pets allowed?**
Yes, pets are welcome.

**What languages do the hosts speak?**
Polish, English, and Czech.

**Is there a minimum stay?**
Yes, minimum 2 nights.

**Can I book just for work (no leisure)?**
Yes — the workation package is specifically designed for remote professionals who want to work during the day and enjoy nature in the evenings.

**Is it suitable for families with children?**
Yes — alpaca walks, farm animals, and mountain nature make it ideal for families.

**Can I adopt an alpaca?**
You can symbolically adopt an alpaca and support the farm: https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/pl/adopt
